SELECT rb.id AS id, rb.subject AS subject, rb.created_at AS created_at, rb.hit AS hit, rb.image_url AS image_url, rb.rcp_seq AS rcp_seq,
u1.id AS writer_id, u1.nickname AS writer_nickname, u1.profile_image_url AS writer_profile_image,
rec.rcp_nm AS rcp_nm, rec.att_file_no_main AS att_file_no_main,
u2.id AS chef_id, u2.nickname AS chef_nickname, u2.profile_image_url AS chef_profile_image
FROM review_board rb LEFT OUTER JOIN users u1 ON rb.users_id = u1.id LEFT OUTER JOIN recipe rec ON rb.rcp_seq = rec.rcp_seq LEFT OUTER JOIN users u2 ON rec.user_id = u2.id
UPPER(rb.content) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
UPPER(u1.nickname) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
UPPER(rb.subject) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
ORDER BY rb.id DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 12 ROWS ONLY

SELECT CEIL(COUNT(*) / 12.0) FROM review_board rb LEFT OUTER JOIN users u1 ON rb.users_id = u1.id
UPPER(rb.content) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
UPPER(u1.nickname) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
UPPER(rb.subject) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
SELECT id, subject, image_url, created_at FROM review_board WHERE users_id = #{users_id} AND id != #{id} ORDER BY id DESC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 4 ROWS ONLY
SELECT id, subject, image_url FROM review_board WHERE rcp_seq = #{rcp_seq} AND id != #{id} ORDER BY id DESC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 4 ROWS ONLY

SELECT r.id AS id, r.review_board_id AS review_board_id, r.users_id AS users_id, r.content AS content, r.created_at AS created_at,
u.nickname AS writer_nickname, u.profile_image_url AS writer_profile_image
FROM review_board_reply r LEFT OUTER JOIN users u ON r.users_id = u.id WHERE r.review_board_id = #{review_board_id} ORDER BY r.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_board ( id, subject, content, image_url, image_size, rcp_seq, users_id, hit, created_at ) VALUES ( seq_review_board.NEXTVAL, #{subject}, #{content}, #{image_url, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{image_size, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{rcp_seq}, #{users_id}, 0, SYSDATE )
INSERT INTO review_board_reply ( id, review_board_id, users_id, content, created_at ) VALUES ( seq_review_board_reply.NEXTVAL, #{review_board_id}, #{users_id}, #{content}, SYSDATE )
